Variables.Name: moveSpeed
Variables.Meaning: Player movement speed in Unity units per second.

Variables.Meaning: Maximum turning speed in degrees per second.

Variables.Name: gravity
Variables.Meaning: Downward acceleration applied to the player.

Subfiles.Name: PlayerCamera.TargetSettings
Subfiles.Purpose: Chooses the object the camera follows and the point on that object it looks toward.

Subfiles.Name: PlayerCamera.DistanceSettings
Subfiles.Purpose: Controls the normal follow distance and prevents the camera from moving too close to the player.

Subfiles.Name: PlayerCamera.ClippingSettings
Subfiles.Purpose: Controls which walls block the camera and how much clearance it keeps from them.

Subfiles.Name: PlayerCamera.Lifecycle
Subfiles.Receives: Unity frame update and camera settings
Subfiles.Purpose: Places the camera behind the target using a distance that avoids walls.

Subfiles.Name: PlayerCamera.Collision
Subfiles.Receives: Focus point, camera direction, and clipping settings
Subfiles.Purpose: Checks for walls and shortens the camera distance to keep it in front of the obstruction.

Variables.Name: target
Variables.Meaning: The player or object followed by the camera.

Variables.Name: targetOffset
Variables.Meaning: Moves the camera focus point above the target origin.

Variables.Name: cameraDistance
Variables.Meaning: The preferred distance between the camera and target.

Variables.Name: minimumDistance
Variables.Meaning: The closest the camera may move toward the target.

Variables.Name: collisionRadius
Variables.Meaning: The thickness of the wall check around the camera path.

Variables.Name: wallPadding
Variables.Meaning: Extra clearance maintained between the camera and a wall.

Variables.Name: collisionLayers
Variables.Meaning: The Unity layers treated as camera-blocking walls.
